description: This is a source code file for a Python implementation of a text-to-speech (TTS) service using Groq's TTS API. It defines the `GroqTTSService` class, which provides methods for configuring and executing speech synthesis, including handling external dependencies, configurations, and response processing.

classes.name: GroqTTSService
classes.description: Implementation of a TTS service using Groq's API, supports speech synthesis with configuration options and asynchronous processing.
